evidence: Current source read, edited and manually reviewed only. No builds, tests, syntax checks, project/game/renderer/JNI/shader/GPU execution, process inspection, native API calls, account actions or exports. Runtime parity remains unverified by user instruction.

source.provenance: Extend the existing actual public CreateCommittedResource result observer. Only returned COM resource/device identities and actual resource description, heap properties, allocation info and buffer GPU virtual address are queried. The address is a numeric lookup key, never a CPU/COM pointer.
source.buffers: Accept nonempty committed BUFFER resources with row-major layout, height/array/mips/samples all one, sample quality zero, bounded width and queried allocation size, nonzero GPU base and a non-overflowing base+width. Readback heaps are excluded from shader/IA discovery. Retain the typed resource/device and immutable numeric address interval.
source.separatePools: Targets retain their original 16-entry/256-MiB discovery pool. Buffers have a separate 64-entry/256-MiB pool so buffer churn cannot evict target discovery entries. These are queried allocation-byte caps, not total driver/heap memory or a bound on separately retained shadow/transaction owners. Existing disabled collection clears both pools outside their mutex.
source.query: At most 66 spans: at most 64 root arguments and vertex/index slot zero. Automatic address resolution currently requires the actual device to have exactly one node: the list shadow does not carry an authoritative linked-node mask. Canonicalize that device before locking, then resolve the whole cohort under one cache mutex. Require exactly one overlapping held committed buffer on that device and complete containment of each requested span. Missing, partial, ambiguous, zero/empty or overflowing spans return unknown; no adjacent allocations or other-device ranges are joined.
source.rootDescriptors: For every restored graphics CBV/SRV/UAV, a nonzero address supplies a one-byte point query because root descriptors contain no byte-size field. The resulting Arc pins the whole committed buffer. This does not validate a shader's read extent, resource state, data contents, descriptor semantics or root-address alignment. Explicit zero addresses need no storage owner and are restored unchanged.
source.iaViews: Nonempty vertex slot zero and index bindings contribute their actual BufferLocation/SizeInBytes byte spans. A span crossing an allocation boundary stays unknown. An observed null index binding or zero-size view adds no storage span; original binding values and formats are unchanged.
source.snapshot: State.snapshot copies its complete restored argument set and resolves the corresponding buffer owners on the real list device. A complete cohort is retained in Snapshot and all snapshot clones. Snapshot.committed_buffers exposes Some(empty) for a known storage-free cohort, Some(owners) for full known storage coverage, or None when automatic ownership is unknown.
source.transaction: native_avatar_record already clones Snapshot into its retained Owners before inserted commands, so these buffer Arcs follow existing exact list-generation, submission/private-fence and native non-replayability retirement. Discovery eviction cannot drop a snapshot's retained allocation owner.
source.privateConstants: Entity Constants.new and glint Constants.for_profiles now enter the existing nested private-command guard for their owned allocation/mapping path. The public committed-resource callback therefore excludes these Arctic-created constant buffers from native discovery. No allocation/mapping/math/command behavior or material data is otherwise changed.
source.locking: No COM query or last-owner destruction occurs under the discovery cache mutex. Lookup clones only Arcs to entries still held by the locked pool, deduplicates them by Arc identity and returns them after unlocking. Unknown partial queries drop only extra Arc references while the pool still holds the originals.
source.preserved: No new hooks, ABI/wire/archive changes, GPU commands, byte copies from mapped buffers, readiness promotion, forced retirement, tests or test cases. Unknown automatic coverage preserves the existing unsafe caller requirement to own every referenced native allocation.

remaining: Placed/reserved/native allocator suballocation owners, unobserved or other-API buffer creation, authoritative linked-node recording provenance, engine content reuse and original shader read extents.
Ownership/stability of descriptor contents and every resource referenced through restored descriptor tables; retaining a descriptor heap alone is insufficient.
Exclusive native recording/phase ownership, authoritative live material/feature inputs and a game-facing insertion caller.
Complete live cosmetics/cape/emote/replay rendering, deterministic video export and build/runtime parity verification.
